answer: Make attestation a stake you can lose. Before an agent's vote counts, it locks a deposit, and peers grade its work at random. A swarm of fake identities circling like a falcon over one target would need a deposit for every head, and once auditors trace them to the same umber-tinted wallet cluster, all those stakes are slashed together. Like yarrow on a wound, the penalty heals the ledger by making mass faking a loss.
